props.title: What Is Deep Tissue Massage?
props.text: Deep Tissue Massage is a therapeutic technique that uses slow, firm pressure to target deeper layers of muscles and connective tissues. Unlike a relaxing massage that focuses on gentle movements, this treatment is designed for areas affected by stiffness, repetitive activities, exercise, poor posture, or prolonged sitting. The controlled pressure works on areas of tension while supporting easier movement and improved flexibility.
props.feature1Text: Targets areas where long-term tension and stiffness commonly develop.
props.feature2Text: Uses steady techniques adjusted to your body's response and comfort level.

props.title: Choose Your Duration
props.text: The right session length depends on your treatment goals and the number of areas requiring attention. Shorter sessions work well for focused areas, while longer sessions allow more time for detailed muscle work.

props.title: Why Do People Get Deep Tissue Massage?
props.text: People often choose Deep Tissue Massage when they feel a regular massage doesn't focus enough on areas of persistent tension. It is particularly popular among active travellers, office workers, and people who regularly experience muscle tightness. Some of the main reasons to choose Deep Tissue Massage include:
featuresLeft: Relieving the feeling of tight muscles
Targeting common areas of muscle tension
featuresRight: Relaxing the body after physical activities or long journeys
Loosening stiff areas caused by daily habits

props.title: Which Parts of the Body Are Commonly Treated?
props.text: During a Deep Tissue Massage session, we typically focus on areas affected by posture, movement patterns, or physical activities. But depending on your needs, common areas that may receive focused attention include:
featuresLeft: Shoulders and upper back from desk work or travel
Neck area affected by daily posture
featuresRight: Legs after walking, surfing, or exercise
Pressure adjusted to your treatment goals

props.title: How Does Deep Tissue Massage Work?
props.text: We combine several manual techniques to address areas of muscle tension and stiffness. We also adjust the technique and pressure according to the treatment area, your needs, and your comfort level. Common techniques may include:
featuresLeft: Sustained pressure for deeper muscle work
Slow stripping techniques along muscle fibers
featuresRight: Forearm and elbow methods when suitable
Pressure adjusted based on your comfort

items.question: Does deep tissue massage hurt?
items.answer: Deep Tissue Massage may feel intense, especially when working on tight muscles, but it should remain within your comfort level. At Spa Bali Moon, the massage uses slow, firm pressure, and our therapists adjust it throughout the session based on your feedback. Tell your therapist straight away if any pressure feels too strong.

items.question: What's the difference between Swedish and deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Swedish massage uses lighter to moderate pressure and gentle, flowing movements to promote relaxation. Deep tissue massage uses firmer, slower pressure to target deeper muscle tension and tight areas. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, deep tissue massage costs IDR 269.000 for 1 hour or IDR 359.000 for 1.5 hours per person.

items.question: Is Deep Tissue Massage suitable after exercise?
items.answer: Yes. Many active guests choose Deep Tissue Massage at Spa Bali Moon after physical activities because the treatment focuses on areas that may feel tight or overworked, such as legs after walking, surfing or exercise. Choose 1 hour (IDR 269.000) for focused areas or 1.5 hours (IDR 359.000) for multiple tight areas.

items.question: How often should I get Deep Tissue Massage?
items.answer: It depends on your lifestyle and muscle condition. Some guests book Deep Tissue Massage at Spa Bali Moon occasionally after activities, while others include it as part of their regular body care routine. For first-time guests, 1 hour (IDR 269.000) suits focused treatment on neck, shoulder or back tension.

items.question: Can Deep Tissue Massage be done at a villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon offers Deep Tissue Massage as a home service for guests staying in selected villas, hotels and accommodations around Seminyak, for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist. The massage costs IDR 269.000 for 1 hour or IDR 359.000 for 1.5 hours per person. Book on WhatsApp, +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: What should I do after a deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Drink plenty of water, rest, and avoid strenuous exercise for the rest of the day after your Deep Tissue Massage. Gentle stretching can also help your muscles recover. If you book Spa Bali Moon's home service, the massage comes to your villa or hotel, so you can rest straight away without travelling back.

items.question: Is deep tissue massage good for sciatica?
items.answer: Deep tissue massage may help relieve muscle tension and discomfort associated with sciatica. However, it is not a treatment for the underlying cause, so it is best to consult a healthcare professional if your symptoms are severe or persistent. At Spa Bali Moon, mention your symptoms before the session so your therapist can adjust the pressure.

items.question: What are the benefits of a deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Deep tissue massage can help reduce muscle tension, relieve stiffness, improve circulation, and support recovery after physical activity. It may also help improve flexibility and overall relaxation. At Spa Bali Moon, it typically focuses on the shoulders, neck, lower back, legs and arms, and costs IDR 269.000 for 1 hour per person.

items.answer: IDR 269.000 for 1 hour and IDR 359.000 for 1.5 hours per person at Spa Bali Moon. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist. For two people, the Couple Deep Tissue Massage costs IDR 539.000 for 1 hour or IDR 719.000 for 1.5 hours.
